title: Happy hedgehog
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6d6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd35c'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- back spines: layered browns -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='30' cy='45' r='13' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='45' r='13' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='32' r='12' fill='#8f5a25'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='12' fill='#8f5a25'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='13' fill='#a8712f'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='58' r='11' fill='#8f5a25'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='58' r='11' fill='#8f5a25'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#9b6530'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='20' fill='#b57a38'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spikes tips lighter -->
  <g fill='#d79a52'>
    <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='6'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='32' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='40' r='5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#f2c99a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffe2b8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='4' fill='#5a3b22'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#3a2414'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#3a2414'/>
  <circle cx='43.2' cy='58.8' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.2' cy='58.8' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='4' fill='#f79a9a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='68' r='4' fill='#f79a9a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 76 Q50 81 56 76' stroke='#8a5a34' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='5' fill='#e0a774'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='50' r='5' fill='#e0a774'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8f5a25'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8f5a25'/>
</svg>
